Uploaded APKs have to meet the target API level rules below.

Starting August 31 2026:

  • New apps and app updates must target Android 16 (API level 36) or higher. Exempt from that: Wear OS and Android Automotive OS apps, which must target Android 15 (API level 35) or higher; Android TV and Android XR apps, which must target Android 14 (API level 34) or higher.
  • Existing apps must target Android 15 (API level 35) or higher to stay visible to new users on newer OS versions.

Teams that need more time can ask for an extension to November 1, 2026.
